game.title: Dungeon Siege III
game.blurb: Action RPG for one to four players set in the land of Ehb, from Obsidian Entertainment (published by Square Enix), released 2011-05-31. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Restoring the Legion and saving Ehb, with the big choices along the way. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: The Four Heroes
chapters.summary: Finishing the main quest and reaching level 20 as Lucas, Anjali, Katarina and Reinhart.

chapters.title: Companions and Choices
chapters.summary: Gathering the Legion descendants, companion influence and agreeing or disagreeing in dialogue.

chapters.title: The Desert and the Abbey
chapters.summary: The desert shrines, the Temple of Azunai, Sandspring Cavern, the Agallan Vault and the Abbey of St. Hiram.

chapters.title: Co-op Play
chapters.summary: Playing with friends: four-player parties, joining other games and co-op boss fights.

chapters.title: Boss Feats and Mastery
chapters.summary: Special ways to beat bosses, the highest difficulty, every side quest, lore, gear and gold.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Dungeon Siege III" or "Dungeon Siege 3" (API returned missing). dungeonsiege.fandom.com answers the API under "Dungeon Siege III", with about 123 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "ValveTestApp39160" (a placeholder name); the store list confirms app 39160 as "Dungeon Siege III". 10 of 54 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they sit in the main story chapter. Four of them ("Lescanzi Ally", "Legion Caretaker", "Royalist Ally", "Liberator") look like story choices rather than plain story beats. Achievements 45 and 47 to 54 (the desert, High Priest Molochi, the Giant Sand Worm, the Agallan Vault, the Abbey of St. Hiram) form a late block of the schema with similar unlock rates (about 6 to 8%); they may be an add-on, but no achievement text says so, so the chapter is named after the places. "It Ain't Lion" (spoke to the Lamasu) was grouped with them by its place in the schema; that is a judgement call. RAWG lists a playtime of only 2 hours, which looks low.
